thesis: 기계적 판정을 유지해 NVDA를 컴파운더형 NORMAL_CANDIDATE로 확정한다. Core 79.0, ex-val 81.82, DI 90, Hard Veto 전부 cleared다. 장기 해자·재투자·재무생존은 강하지만 EV 63과 AS 68.5가 보여주듯 현재가의 안전마진과 power-law 비대칭은 중간 수준이다. 목표 비중은 2~4%로 두되 최초 진입은 약 2%, macro 0.9x pacing으로 분할한다.

evidence.claim: Mechanical aggregation is complete at score 79.0, ex-valuation 81.82, 100% coverage, with the primary archetype classified as compounder and all Hard Vetoes cleared after Red Team review.

The deterministic valuation model gives Bear/Base/Bull values of about $99/$251/$581 versus the frozen $219.34 price, so the current price does not require a Bull outcome but the Base margin of safety is only moderate.
The strongest positive domains are structural leadership 86.25, reinvestment/FCF 85.5, moat trajectory 83.75 and financial survival 81.5; expectation/valuation is 63.0 and asymmetry 68.5.

Evidence Audit and Red Team both identified financing-supported demand, $366B commitments, gross guarantees of $108.5B, DSO 60 days and custom-silicon displacement as the main variables that can invalidate the thesis, while neither found a confirmed Hard Veto.
evidence.value: ED support; RT oppose; veto gate CLEARED

evidence.claim: Macro overlay is 0.9 because real yields are restrictive while credit spreads remain benign; per strategy this changes purchase pacing, not the company score or archetype.

counterevidence: The Base DCF has only a moderate valuation cushion and about two-thirds of Base operating value comes from terminal value, so long-horizon assumption error remains important.

A plausible failure path is that DSO, guarantees and supply commitments grow faster than FCF while hyperscaler custom silicon takes incremental workloads, converting an asset-light platform into a more capital-intensive demand-support model.
Current market capitalization makes a 5x/10x power-law outcome substantially harder than in NVIDIA's earlier lifecycle; AS therefore remains below the emerging-outlier/moonshot threshold.
Rubin's 30x/35x economics are still primarily company-supplied workload-specific benchmarks rather than independently verified customer economics.
unknowns: Independent customer-level Rubin TCO/ROI after power, financing and deployment costs
Expected-loss distribution and recourse terms for the $108.5B gross guarantee exposure
Long-run share of top hyperscaler AI workloads captured by internal/custom accelerators
falsifiers: FCF conversion weakens for several quarters while DSO, AR concentration, guarantees and supply commitments continue rising faster than revenue.
Major hyperscalers structurally move a large share of incremental AI workloads to internal/custom silicon and NVIDIA's gross margin/moat metrics weaken.
Normalized owner-FCF/share misses the Base path for two fiscal years without a commensurate valuation reset or offsetting platform evidence.

key_kpis.name: Normalized owner FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: Track at or above the Base path after working-capital normalization

key_kpis.name: Demand-quality balance sheet
key_kpis.threshold: DSO, AR concentration and guarantee/commitment exposure do not outgrow revenue/FCF for multiple quarters

key_kpis.name: Rubin/custom-silicon economics
key_kpis.threshold: Independent customer TCO remains favorable and custom-silicon displacement stays limited

next_checks: Q3 FY27 actual revenue, gross margin, FCF, DSO and guarantee/commitment updates
Independent Rubin customer economics and repeat-order evidence
FY28 hyperscaler custom-ASIC deployment share and NVIDIA platform attach
position_range: 2-4% target; initial ~2%, staged at 0.9x macro pacing
archetype_rationale: Mechanical compounder classification is retained. Moat, reinvestment, management and survival clear compounder thresholds; AS 68.5 prevents emerging-outlier/moonshot classification despite DI 90.
